```{python}
for i in range(0,8):
    temp_edit = to_edit.iloc[i].copy()
    two_names = temp_edit['Mistral_scientific_name'].split('\n')
    two_names = [name.strip() for name in two_names]

    one_row = temp_edit.copy()
    two_row = temp_edit.copy()
    one_row.loc['Mistral_scientific_name'] =  two_names[0]
    two_row.loc['Mistral_scientific_name'] =  two_names[1]

    df.loc[max(df.index)+1] = one_row
    df.loc[max(df.index)+1] = two_row
```
